Frontend Developer.description: Develops responsive, dynamic, and interactive web user interfaces with modern frontend frameworks.

Backend Developer.description: Designs, develops, and maintains server-side architecture, databases, and core application APIs.

Full-Stack Developer.description: Builds end-to-end web applications, handling both client-side UI and server-side backend databases.

Python Developer.description: Engineers robust backend servers, scalable automation scripts, and RESTful APIs using Python ecosystems.

AI/Generative AI Engineer.description: Builds state-of-the-art Generative AI applications, RAG systems, and customized LLM workflows.

DevOps Engineer.description: Automates cloud infrastructure, build pipelines, continuous integration, and application monitoring.

Software Engineer.description: Solves complex computational problems, engineers clean modular software architecture, and writes maintainable code.
